The '''Great Chott salt flat''' was a sodium-rich desert flat on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="FF72" /> It was located in the southeastern end of the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]]<ref name="ItWoSWT" /> and bordered the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]]. The most important settlement of the Great Chott was the city of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]]. A network of [[Moisture farm/Legends|moisture farms]],<ref name="FF72" /> including the homesteads of the [[Lars family/Legends|Lars]] and [[Darklighter family/Legends|Darklighter]] families,<ref name="ItWoSWT" /> was organized around Anchorhead, making water extraction the principal business of the town and the region.<ref name="FF72" />
